name: Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentación, S.A.
summary: Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentación, S.A. engages in the wholesale and retail of food products in Spain and Argentina. The company offers products and services through owned or franchised self-service stores. It is also involved in the distribution of food and toiletries; leasing of business premises; provision of services to suppliers. In addition, the company is involved in lending and credit operations, including consumer loans, mortgages, and financing of commercial transactions, as well as issuing and managing of credit and debit cards.
